excerpt: The ICARUS-T600, with a total active mass of 476 ton, is the first large-scale operating LAr-TPC detector: it consists of two large and identical adjacent modules with internal dimensions 3.6 × 3.9 × 19.6 m³, filled with a total of 760 tons of ultra-pure liquid argon.
publisher: ICARUS Collaboration / European Physical Journal C
title: ICARUS at the Fermilab Short-Baseline Neutrino program — Initial Operation
